user.title: HA AI
user.description: Choose a provider. Base URL and models are optional: leave them empty to use the provider presets. Pollinations needs no key and only generates images; fill a chat model to enable data generation and evaluation.

data.base_url: Base URL (optional, blank uses the provider preset)
data.chat_model: Chat model (optional, blank uses the provider preset)
data.image_model: Image model (optional, blank uses the provider preset)

error.api_key_required: This provider requires an API key.

abort.already_configured: This provider and models are already configured.

init.title: HA AI options
init.description: Leave Base URL or models empty to fall back to the provider presets. Fill a chat model to enable the conversation agent, and a speech model to enable speech-to-text / text-to-speech. Select the 'assist' API so the agent can control devices.

data.base_url: Base URL (optional, blank uses the provider preset)
data.chat_model: Chat model (optional, blank uses the provider preset)
data.image_model: Image model (optional, blank uses the provider preset)
data.stt_model: Speech-to-text model (optional, blank uses the provider preset; SiliconFlow: FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall)
data.tts_model: Text-to-speech model (optional, blank uses the provider preset; SiliconFlow: FunAudioLLM/CosyVoice2-0.5B)
data.llm_hass_api: Home Assistant APIs the agent may use (select 'assist' to control devices)
data.prompt: System prompt (optional, blank uses the Home Assistant default)
